13:50 Local Time, 00:50 GMT, 06:20 IST: India took control of the T20I series early, winning the first three matches to seal the series, eventually securing a 3-2 victory in the shortest format. India are in a similar position in the ODI series, having won the first two games before the third ODI was washed out. With two matches remaining, the ODI series can either be sealed by India or New Zealand can fight back to level it at 2-2. On that note, hello and welcome, to our coverage of the fourth ODI! The final two matches will be played in Mount Maunganui, where the weather conditions are expected to be much more favourable compared to the earlier games.

The Indian pacers have capitalised brilliantly on the early bowling conditions, making crucial breakthroughs with the new ball. Their ability to generate swing, maintain accuracy and hit the right lengths has kept the opposition batters under constant pressure. Gurnoor Brar has led the way for India with an impressive seven wickets in the series, while Arshdeep Singh and Anshul Kamboj have also made valuable contributions, picking up four wickets apiece. For New Zealand, Jacob Duffy has been the standout performer with the ball. However, his efforts have not received enough support from the batters, whose inconsistency has prevented the team from making the most of his bowling contributions. Something New Zealand will be keen to address as they head into the final two ODIs of the series.

With the bat, Virat Kohli was among the runs for the Men in Blue in the series opener, but Rohit Sharma is yet to find his rhythm and will be eager to make a significant contribution in the remaining matches. New Zealand will be desperate to turn things around, with their backs against the wall heading into this crucial encounter. Having won the last two matches of the T20I series, the Black Caps have shown they have the quality to fight back. With home conditions in their favour, they will be hoping to carry that advantage into today’s clash at Mount Maunganui. Stay tuned for the toss and teams..
